levels.name: A1+
levels.title: Pradmenų įtvirtinimas
levels.description: Įtvirtinsi A1 pagrindus: prisistatyti, papasakoti apie kasdienybę, namus ir laisvalaikį, apsipirkti ir užsisakyti. Pabaigoje – trumpas egzaminas pagal A2 Key kalbėjimo pirmąją dalį.

lessons.title: Veiksmažodis „to be“ ir įvardžiai
lessons.titleEn: To be + subject pronouns + possessive adjectives
lessons.focus: Present of 'be' (am/is/are) in positive, negative (isn't/aren't) and questions with short answers; subject pronouns; possessive adjectives my/your/his/her/its/our/their; L1 trap: never drop 'be' or the subject (*I teacher, *Is cold).
lessons.canDo: Galiu prisistatyti ir paklausti kito žmogaus vardo, kilmės, amžiaus ir darbo.

lessons.title: Šalys, tautybės, profesijos ir skaičiai
lessons.focus: Countries and nationality adjectives (Lithuania/Lithuanian, Poland/Polish…), 25 common jobs with a/an (an engineer, a nurse), numbers 1–100, ages, the alphabet and spelling names/emails (at, dot).
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, iš kur esu ir kuo dirbu, ir paraidžiui padiktuoti savo vardą bei el. paštą.

lessons.title: Pasisveikinimas ir susipažinimas
lessons.focus: Hello/Hi, Nice to meet you, How are you? – Fine, thanks; introducing others (This is…); formal vs informal greetings; asking for repetition and spelling: Sorry? Can you say that again? How do you spell that?
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasisveikinti, pristatyti kitą žmogų ir paprašyti pakartoti, jei nesupratau.

lessons.title: „Have got“ ir savybinis 's
lessons.focus: have got/has got (+ – ?) for family and possessions; possessive 's and s' (my sister's car, my parents' house); whose? L1 trap: *the car of my sister.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie savo šeimą ir ką turiu.

lessons.title: Šeima ir išvaizda
lessons.focus: Family members (parents, husband/wife, cousin, in-laws), describing appearance: tall/short, slim, long/short/curly hair, beard, glasses; word order with adjectives (She has long dark hair); look like.
lessons.canDo: Galiu trumpai apibūdinti savo šeimos narius ir jų išvaizdą.

lessons.title: Garsai „th“ /θ ð/ ir /w/–/v/
lessons.focus: Dental fricatives /θ/ (three, think, Thursday) and /ð/ (this, mother, they) – avoid /t d s f/ substitutions; /w/ (we, where, wife) vs /v/ (very, live, seven) minimal pairs: west/vest, wine/vine.
lessons.canDo: Galiu aiškiai ištarti „th“ ir atskirti /w/ nuo /v/ kasdieniuose žodžiuose.

lessons.title: Pokalbis apie mane (A2 Key 1 dalis)
lessons.focus: Short reading: three personal profiles; comprehension questions; then A2 Key Speaking Part 1-style interview: name, where you live, who you live with, job; giving an extra sentence of detail (because/and).
lessons.canDo: Galiu atsakyti į asmeninius klausimus ir pridėti vieną papildomą detalę.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: žmonės ir aš
lessons.focus: Mixed review: be, have got, possessives, family/jobs/countries vocabulary, greeting dialogue, th and w/v sounds; mini role-play meeting a new colleague.
lessons.canDo: Galiu laisvai prisistatyti ir papasakoti apie savo šeimą.

units.title: Kasdienybė
units.topic: Daily routines, time, work and free time habits

lessons.title: Esamasis paprastasis laikas: teiginiai
lessons.focus: Present simple affirmative for routines and facts; third person -s/-es spelling (works, watches, goes, studies); has; L1 trap: forgetting -s with he/she/it.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie savo ir kitų žmonių įprastą dieną.

lessons.title: Esamasis paprastasis: neiginiai ir klausimai
lessons.focus: do/does + base form in questions and negatives (don't/doesn't), short answers (Yes, I do), wh-questions (Where do you work? What time does she get up?); L1 trap: *You like coffee? *He don't.
lessons.canDo: Galiu paklausti apie kito žmogaus įpročius ir atsakyti trumpais atsakymais.

lessons.title: Dienotvarkė, laikas ir laiko prielinksniai
lessons.titleEn: Daily routine, telling the time, at/on/in
lessons.focus: Routine collocations (get up, have breakfast, go to work, get home, go to bed), telling the time (quarter past, half past, twenty to), days, months, at/on/in with time (at 7, on Monday, in July, in the morning, at the weekend).
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kada ką nors darau, ir teisingai vartoti at/on/in.

lessons.title: Dažnumo prieveiksmiai
lessons.focus: always/usually/often/sometimes/hardly ever/never – position (before main verb, after be); How often…? once/twice a week, every day; L1 trap: *I go always.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kaip dažnai ką nors darau.

lessons.title: Susitarimas dėl susitikimo
lessons.focus: Asking about time and availability: What time is it? Are you free on Friday? Let's meet at… What about 6? That's fine / Sorry, I can't; days and times in arrangements; saying goodbye (See you on…).
lessons.canDo: Galiu susitarti dėl susitikimo laiko ir vietos.

lessons.title: Galūnė -s ir skardieji priebalsiai gale
lessons.focus: Three pronunciations of -s/-es: /s/ (works), /z/ (plays, goes), /ɪz/ (watches); keeping final voiced consonants and vowel length (bag vs back, dog vs dock, has /hæz/) – Lithuanian final devoicing.
lessons.canDo: Galiu teisingai ištarti trečiojo asmens galūnę ir žodžių galą.

lessons.title: Vienos dienos istorija
lessons.titleEn: A day in the life – reading and talking
lessons.focus: Graded text 'A day in the life of a bus driver/nurse'; true/false and wh-questions; comparing with your own day; sequencing with first, then, after that.
lessons.canDo: Galiu suprasti trumpą tekstą apie kasdienybę ir palyginti jį su savo diena.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: kasdienybė
lessons.focus: Present simple +/–/?, frequency adverbs, time prepositions, routine vocabulary, arranging to meet; role-play: interviewing a colleague about their week.
lessons.canDo: Galiu sklandžiai papasakoti apie savo savaitę.

units.title: Namai ir miestas
units.topic: House and home, places in town, neighbourhood

lessons.title: There is / there are ir artikeliai
lessons.focus: there is/are (+ – ?), Is there a…? How many… are there?; a/an vs some/any with plurals; first mention a → then the; L1 trap: Lithuanian has no articles – *There is big park.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kas yra mano namuose ir rajone.

lessons.title: Kambariai, baldai ir vietos prielinksniai
lessons.focus: Rooms and furniture (living room, wardrobe, shelf, sofa, fridge), prepositions in/on/under/next to/between/opposite/in front of/behind; flat vs house, floor (on the third floor).
lessons.canDo: Galiu apibūdinti savo butą ir pasakyti, kur kas yra.

lessons.title: Can / can't: gebėjimas ir leidimas
lessons.focus: can/can't for ability, possibility and permission (+ – ?), short answers; Can I park here? Can you swim?; pronunciation of can /kən/ vs can't /kɑːnt/.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ką moku ir ko nemoku, ir paprašyti leidimo.

lessons.title: Vietos mieste ir apibūdinimas
lessons.focus: Places (post office, chemist's, bank, supermarket, station, library), adjectives to describe places: quiet/noisy, clean/dirty, modern/old, safe/dangerous, beautiful; very/quite/really.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, kas yra mano mieste ir koks jis.

lessons.title: Kaip nueiti? Kelio klausimas
lessons.focus: Excuse me, is there a… near here? How do I get to…? Go straight on, turn left/right, take the second street on the left, it's on the corner, it's opposite…; checking: So I turn left at the bank?
lessons.canDo: Galiu paklausti kelio ir suprasti paprastus nurodymus.

lessons.title: Liepiamoji nuosaka ir this/that/these/those
lessons.focus: Imperatives (+ and Don't…) for instructions and signs; this/that/these/those for near/far, singular/plural; one/ones.
lessons.canDo: Galiu duoti paprastus nurodymus ir parodyti daiktus.

lessons.title: Mano namai ir kaimynystė
lessons.focus: Graded text: two people describe their neighbourhoods; matching and gap questions; describing a simple picture of a street (There is…, On the left…); talking about what you like in your area.
lessons.canDo: Galiu apibūdinti savo rajoną ir paprastą paveikslėlį.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: namai ir miestas
lessons.focus: there is/are, articles, can, imperatives, demonstratives, home and town vocabulary, directions; role-play: showing a friend round your flat and explaining how to get to the shop.
lessons.canDo: Galiu laisvai papasakoti apie savo namus ir miestą.

units.title: Maistas, apsipirkimas ir laisvalaikis
units.topic: Food and drink, shopping, clothes, hobbies

lessons.title: Skaičiuojami ir neskaičiuojami daiktavardžiai
lessons.focus: Countable vs uncountable nouns (apple/bread/water/money), some/any, How much/How many…? a lot of; containers: a bottle of, a packet of, a kilo of; L1 trap: *breads, *informations.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ko reikia nupirkti, ir paklausti apie kiekį.

lessons.title: Maistas, gėrimai ir kainos
lessons.focus: Common food and drink (vegetables, fruit, meat, fish, dairy), meals, prices (£4.50, €12.99), How much is it/are they?; I'm hungry/thirsty.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie mėgstamą maistą ir pasakyti kainas.

lessons.title: Kavinėje: užsisakymas
lessons.focus: Can I have…? I'd like… Could I have…? Anything else? Eat in or take away? Here you are; asking for the bill; polite would like vs want.
lessons.canDo: Galiu mandagiai užsisakyti kavinėje ir susimokėti.

lessons.title: Like/love/hate + -ing ir objekto įvardžiai
lessons.focus: like/love/enjoy/don't mind/hate + -ing; would like + to (difference from like); object pronouns me/you/him/her/it/us/them.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ką mėgstu ir ko nemėgstu daryti.

lessons.title: Parduotuvėje: drabužiai
lessons.focus: Clothes and colours; Can I help you? I'm just looking. Have you got this in a medium/in blue? Can I try it on? Where are the changing rooms? It's too big. I'll take it.
lessons.canDo: Galiu nusipirkti drabužį: paklausti dydžio, spalvos, pasimatuoti ir sumokėti.

lessons.title: Esamasis eigos laikas
lessons.titleEn: Present continuous – now and around now
lessons.focus: am/is/are + -ing (+ – ?), spelling (making, sitting); now vs usually – contrast with present simple; describing what people are doing in a picture.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ką darau dabar, ir apibūdinti, ką daro žmonės paveikslėlyje.

lessons.title: Ilgieji ir trumpieji balsiai
lessons.focus: /ɪ/ vs /iː/ (ship/sheep, live/leave, it/eat), /ʊ/ vs /uː/ (full/fool, look/Luke), /e/ vs /æ/ (bed/bad, men/man); vowel length is meaning-bearing in English.
lessons.canDo: Galiu atskirti ir ištarti ilguosius bei trumpuosius anglų kalbos balsius.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: maistas, apsipirkimas, laisvalaikis
lessons.titleEn: Review: Food, shopping and free time
lessons.focus: Countable/uncountable, like + -ing, present simple vs continuous, food and clothes vocabulary; role-play: café order + clothes shop.
lessons.canDo: Galiu susitvarkyti kasdienėse pirkimo situacijose.

lessons.title: A1+ lygio egzaminas
lessons.focus: Speaking exam modelled on A2 Key Speaking Part 1 (personal interview: name, home, family, routine, free time, extended 'Tell me something about…' answer) plus a short role-play (ordering/asking directions) and a simple picture description with there is / present continuous.
lessons.canDo: Galiu įrodyti, kad esu pasiruošusi A2 lygiui: atsakau į asmeninius klausimus ir susitvarkau paprastose situacijose.

levels.name: A2
levels.title: Kasdienis bendravimas
levels.description: Išmoksi pasakoti apie praeitį, keliones ir planus, lyginti, užsisakyti restorane, pasikalbėti su gydytoju ir darbe. Pabaigoje – pilnas A2 Key kalbėjimo egzamino modelis.

lessons.title: Was / were ir there was / were
lessons.titleEn: Past of be: was/were, there was/were
lessons.focus: was/were (+ – ?), short answers, there was/were; born: I was born in…; past time expressions yesterday, last week, in 2010, ago.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kur ir kada buvau, ir kur gimiau.

lessons.title: Būtasis paprastasis: taisyklingieji veiksmažodžiai
lessons.focus: Past simple affirmative of regular verbs, spelling (stopped, studied, lived); time expressions; talking about last weekend.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, ką veikiau praėjusį savaitgalį.

lessons.title: Būtasis paprastasis: netaisyklingieji veiksmažodžiai
lessons.focus: 40 high-frequency irregular verbs (went, had, got, made, saw, took, bought, came, left, met, said, told…), learning strategies; narrating a simple sequence.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie praeities įvykius vartodama dažniausius netaisyklinguosius veiksmažodžius.

lessons.title: Būtasis paprastasis: klausimai ir neiginiai
lessons.focus: did/didn't + base form; wh-questions in the past (Where did you go? What did you do? Who did you meet?); L1 trap: *Did you went? *I didn't saw.
lessons.canDo: Galiu paklausti kito žmogaus apie jo praeitį ir atsakyti.

lessons.title: Galūnė -ed
lessons.focus: Three pronunciations of -ed: /t/ (worked), /d/ (lived), /ɪd/ (wanted, needed) – not adding an extra syllable; linking -ed to next word.
lessons.canDo: Galiu teisingai ištarti taisyklingųjų veiksmažodžių būtojo laiko formas.

lessons.title: Gyvenimo istorija
lessons.focus: Graded biography of a famous Lithuanian/international person; ordering events, life-event collocations (grow up, leave school, get a job, get married, have children, move to, retire); sequencing first, then, after that, finally; telling your own life story.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti trumpą savo ar kito žmogaus gyvenimo istoriją.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: praeitis
lessons.focus: Past simple of be and full verbs (+ – ?), irregular verbs, -ed pronunciation, life events; interview game 'Find out about my last holiday'.
lessons.canDo: Galiu laisvai kalbėti apie savo praeitį.

lessons.title: Transportas, atostogos ir orai
lessons.focus: Transport (by bus/train/car/plane, on foot), travel verbs (catch/miss a bus, get on/off, take a taxi), holiday collocations: go camping/sightseeing, stay in a hotel, book a flight, pack, rent a car; weather (sunny, rainy, windy, cloudy, foggy, storm, degrees), What's the weather like?
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, kaip keliauju, ką veikiu atostogose ir kokie buvo orai.

lessons.title: Būtasis eigos laikas
lessons.focus: was/were + -ing for background and interrupted actions; when/while; past continuous vs past simple in stories (I was walking to the station when it started to rain).
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, kas vyko tam tikru momentu praeityje ir kas tai nutraukė.

lessons.title: Stotyje ir oro uoste
lessons.focus: Buying tickets: A return to…, please. Single or return? What time is the next train? Which platform? Is this seat free? Check-in, boarding pass, gate, delayed; understanding announcements.
lessons.canDo: Galiu nusipirkti bilietą ir susigaudyti stotyje ar oro uoste.

lessons.title: Viešbutyje: rezervacija ir registracija
lessons.titleEn: At the hotel – booking and checking in
lessons.focus: I'd like to book a double room for two nights. Does it include breakfast? I have a reservation. What time is check-out? Could I have the Wi-Fi password? Spelling and dates on the phone.
lessons.canDo: Galiu užsisakyti kambarį ir užsiregistruoti viešbutyje.

lessons.title: Atostogų istorija ir nuotrauka
lessons.focus: Graded text: a holiday that went wrong; comprehension; telling a holiday story with past simple/continuous; describing a holiday photo (In this picture…, The people are…).
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie atostogas ir apibūdinti atostogų nuotrauką.

lessons.title: Žodžio kirtis
lessons.focus: Stress in 2–3 syllable words (HOliday, hoTEL, aIRport, toMORrow, BREAKfast), weak unstressed syllables; Lithuanian stress habits vs English stress-timing.
lessons.canDo: Galiu teisingai kirčiuoti dažnus dviejų ir trijų skiemenų žodžius.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: kelionės
lessons.focus: Past continuous vs past simple, travel and weather vocabulary, station and hotel dialogues; role-play: arriving in a new city.
lessons.canDo: Galiu susitvarkyti kelionėje ir papasakoti apie ją.

units.title: Miestai ir vietos
units.topic: Places and buildings, comparing places, public transport

lessons.title: Būdvardžių aukštesnysis laipsnis
lessons.focus: -er/more + than, irregular (better, worse, further), (not) as… as; much/a bit + comparative; L1 trap: *more bigger; pronunciation: schwa and weak 'than' /ðən/, 'as' /əz/.
lessons.canDo: Galiu palyginti du miestus, daiktus ar žmones.

lessons.title: Būdvardžių aukščiausiasis laipsnis
lessons.focus: the -est/the most, irregular (the best, the worst), in/of after superlatives (the biggest city in Lithuania), + present perfect ever preview (the best film I've ever seen) as a chunk.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kas yra didžiausias, geriausias ar įdomiausias.

lessons.title: Artikeliai: a/an, the ir be artikelio
lessons.focus: Use of a/an (one of many), the (unique/known/again), zero article with general plurals and uncountables (I like dogs), with cities/countries/streets vs the + rivers, seas, the UK/USA, the city centre; Lithuanian learners' #1 error.
lessons.canDo: Galiu teisingiau vartoti artikelius kalbėdama apie vietas.

lessons.title: Miestas: pastatai ir paslaugos
lessons.focus: Buildings and services (museum, castle, square, shopping centre, town hall, petrol station, hospital), city adjectives (crowded, lively, historic, expensive, polluted), compound nouns (bus stop, car park).
lessons.canDo: Galiu apibūdinti miestą ir jo lankytinas vietas.

lessons.title: Viešasis transportas ir kelio aiškinimas
lessons.focus: Which bus goes to…? Where do I change? How long does it take? It takes about 20 minutes; giving multi-step directions with landmarks; checking and clarifying (Did you say…?).
lessons.canDo: Galiu paklausti apie viešąjį transportą ir paaiškinti kelią turistui.

lessons.title: Du miestai: tinklaraštis ir diskusija
lessons.focus: Graded travel blog comparing Vilnius and another European city; comprehension; A2 Key Part 2 style discussion: which place is better for a weekend and why (Do you like…? Which do you prefer? Why?).
lessons.canDo: Galiu perskaityti trumpą kelionių tinklaraštį ir pasakyti, kurį miestą renkuosi ir kodėl.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: miestai
lessons.focus: Comparatives, superlatives, articles, city vocabulary, transport questions; task: recommend your town to a visitor.
lessons.canDo: Galiu palyginti vietas ir rekomenduoti, ką aplankyti.

lessons.title: Going to: planai ir ketinimai
lessons.focus: be going to + verb for plans/intentions (+ – ?), time expressions (tonight, next weekend, in two weeks); predictions from present evidence (Look at the sky – it's going to rain).
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie savo planus ir ketinimus.

lessons.title: Esamasis eigos laikas ateities susitarimams
lessons.focus: Present continuous for fixed future arrangements (I'm meeting Tom on Friday); contrast with going to; present simple for timetables (The film starts at 8).
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ką jau esu suplanavusi ir susitarusi.

lessons.title: Laisvalaikis ir sportas
lessons.focus: play/go/do + sport (play tennis, go swimming, do yoga), entertainment (concert, exhibition, match, theatre), hobbies; adjectives: exciting, relaxing, boring.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie savo laisvalaikį ir pomėgius.

lessons.title: Kvietimai ir pasiūlymai
lessons.focus: Would you like to…? Do you fancy…? Shall we…? Why don't we…? How about -ing? Accepting (I'd love to) and declining politely with a reason (I'm afraid I can't – I'm working); fixing details.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pakviesti, priimti ar mandagiai atsisakyti kvietimo.

lessons.title: Will: spontaniški sprendimai, pasiūlymai, pažadai
lessons.focus: will/won't for instant decisions (I'll have the soup), offers (I'll help you), promises (I'll call you); Shall I…?; will vs going to.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasiūlyti pagalbą, pažadėti ir priimti sprendimą pokalbio metu.

lessons.title: Sutrumpinimai ir greitoji kalba
lessons.focus: I'll, won't /wəʊnt/ vs want, gonna/going to /gənə/, wanna in informal speech, I'd like, Let's; hearing contractions in fast speech.
lessons.canDo: Galiu ištarti ir išgirsti sutrumpintas formas greitoje kalboje.

lessons.title: Savaitgalio planas (A2 Key 2 dalis)
lessons.titleEn: Planning a weekend – A2 Key Part 2
lessons.focus: A2 Key Speaking Part 2: discussing 5 picture prompts of weekend activities (Do you like…? Which is more fun?), giving reasons, then follow-up questions; listening-style text: friends planning a weekend.
lessons.canDo: Galiu aptarti laisvalaikio pasirinkimus, pasakyti, kas man patinka, ir paaiškinti kodėl.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: planai
lessons.focus: going to, present continuous for future, will, leisure vocabulary, invitations; role-play: organising a birthday evening.
lessons.canDo: Galiu suplanuoti renginį su draugu.

units.title: Maistas ir sveikata
units.topic: Food and drink, restaurants, body and health

lessons.title: Maisto gaminimas ir receptai
lessons.focus: Cooking verbs (boil, fry, bake, chop, mix, add), food adjectives (spicy, sweet, fresh, raw), describing a dish; sequencing a recipe with imperatives.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, kaip pagaminti savo mėgstamą patiekalą.

lessons.title: Kiekybės žodžiai
lessons.focus: much/many/a lot of, a few/a little, too much/too many, (not) enough + noun; any/no; L1 trap: *a lot of informations, *much people.
lessons.canDo: Galiu tiksliai pasakyti, kiek ko valgau, perku ar turiu.

lessons.title: Restorane
lessons.focus: Booking a table by phone; Are you ready to order? I'll have… Could we have…? What do you recommend? Is it spicy? Problems (This isn't what I ordered), asking for the bill, Can we pay separately?
lessons.canDo: Galiu užsisakyti stalelį, patiekalus ir išspręsti paprastą problemą restorane.

lessons.title: Kūnas ir sveikatos problemos
lessons.focus: Parts of the body; I've got a headache/a cold/a sore throat/a temperature/a cough; My back hurts; I feel sick/tired/dizzy; medicine, tablets, pharmacy.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kas man skauda ir kaip jaučiuosi.

lessons.title: Should / shouldn't: patarimai
lessons.focus: should/shouldn't + base form; Should I…? What should I do?; You should see a doctor; weaker/stronger advice: Maybe you should…; ought to (receptive).
lessons.canDo: Galiu duoti ir paprašyti paprasto patarimo.

lessons.title: Pas gydytoją ir vaistinėje
lessons.titleEn: At the doctor's and the pharmacy
lessons.focus: Making an appointment; What's the matter? How long have you had it? (chunk); describing symptoms; understanding instructions (Take one tablet three times a day); asking the pharmacist for something for a cough.
lessons.canDo: Galiu užsiregistruoti pas gydytoją, apibūdinti simptomus ir suprasti nurodymus.

lessons.title: Sveika gyvensena
lessons.focus: Graded article 'Five habits of healthy people'; comprehension and vocabulary; discussion of your own diet and habits using quantifiers and should.
lessons.canDo: Galiu suprasti trumpą straipsnį apie sveikatą ir pasidalinti savo įpročiais.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: maistas ir sveikata
lessons.focus: Quantifiers, should, cooking and health vocabulary, restaurant and doctor role-plays.
lessons.canDo: Galiu susitvarkyti restorane ir pas gydytoją.

units.title: Darbas ir mokslai
units.topic: Jobs, workplace, school and study, phone calls

lessons.title: Darbai ir darbo vieta
lessons.focus: Jobs and workplaces, work collocations (work in an office/from home, work for a company, be in charge of, earn, full-time/part-time, shift, boss, colleague, customer).
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie savo darbą: kur dirbu ir ką darau.

lessons.title: Have to, must, mustn't
lessons.titleEn: Obligation – have to, must, don't have to, mustn't
lessons.focus: have to/don't have to (necessity vs no necessity), must/mustn't (rules, prohibition), had to in the past; contrast don't have to vs mustn't (L1 trap: 'nereikia' vs 'negalima').
lessons.canDo: Galiu paaiškinti darbo taisykles ir ką privalau ar nebūtina daryti.

lessons.title: Prieveiksmiai ir būdvardžiai
lessons.focus: Adjective vs adverb (careful/carefully, good/well, fast/fast, hard/hard), position; L1 trap: *He speaks English good. *drive careful.
lessons.canDo: Galiu apibūdinti, kaip žmonės atlieka darbą.

lessons.title: Veiksmažodis + to ar -ing
lessons.focus: want/need/hope/decide/would like + to; enjoy/finish/mind/like + -ing; infinitive of purpose (I went to the bank to get money); L1 trap: *for to get, *I want that you…
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ko noriu, ką planuoju ir kodėl ką nors darau.

lessons.title: Telefono pokalbiai
lessons.focus: Hello, this is… Can I speak to…? I'm calling about… He's not available – can I take a message? Could you ask her to call me back? Spelling and numbers; Sorry, it's a bad line.
lessons.canDo: Galiu paskambinti, paprašyti pakviesti žmogų ir palikti žinutę.

lessons.title: Darbo skelbimas ir mokymasis
lessons.focus: Graded job advert and an email about a course; school/study vocabulary (subject, exam, pass/fail, course, degree); talking about your education and job requirements.
lessons.canDo: Galiu suprasti darbo skelbimą ir papasakoti apie savo išsilavinimą.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: darbas ir mokslai
lessons.focus: Obligation modals, adverbs, verb + to/-ing, work vocabulary, phone calls; role-play: calling a company about a job.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie darbą ir susitvarkyti telefonu.

lessons.title: A2 lygio egzaminas
lessons.focus: Full A2 Key Speaking model: Part 1 interview (daily life, past weekend, plans) with a 'Tell me something about…' extended answer; Part 2 picture-based discussion of 5 options with reasons and follow-up questions; plus a functional role-play (restaurant / doctor / station).
lessons.canDo: Galiu išlaikyti A2 Key kalbėjimo dalies modelį: kalbu apie save, praeitį ir planus, lyginu ir argumentuoju.

levels.name: A2+
levels.title: Patirtys ir nuomonės
levels.description: Išmoksi kalbėti apie patirtį (Present Perfect), pokyčius, pirkinius, technologijas ir žmones, sąlygas ir prognozes, pateikti nuomonę ir mandagiai prašyti. Pabaigoje – A2 Key / B1 Preliminary pereinamasis egzaminas.

lessons.title: Present Perfect: patirtis (ever/never)
lessons.focus: have/has + past participle; Have you ever…? I've never…; past participles of common irregular verbs; been vs gone; L1 trap: Lithuanian uses past tense – *Did you ever see…?
lessons.canDo: Galiu paklausti apie kito žmogaus patirtį ir papasakoti apie savo.

lessons.title: Present Perfect ar Past Simple?
lessons.focus: Experience (present perfect) → details (past simple): Have you ever been to Italy? – Yes, I went there in 2019; finished time expressions (yesterday, ago, in 2019) block present perfect.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pradėti pokalbį apie patirtį ir papasakoti detales tinkamu laiku.

lessons.title: Just, already, yet
lessons.titleEn: Present perfect with just, already, yet
lessons.focus: Recent events and news: I've just finished; Have you done it yet? I haven't… yet; I've already…; position of the adverbs; British vs American usage (receptive).
lessons.canDo: Galiu pranešti naujienas ir pasakyti, ką jau padariau ar dar ne.

lessons.title: Patirtys ir pasiekimai
lessons.focus: Collocations: win a prize, pass a test, break a bone, run a marathon, meet someone famous, try (new food), learn to…; -ed/-ing adjectives for reacting (amazing, terrifying, embarrassed).
lessons.canDo: Galiu įvairiais žodžiais apibūdinti savo patirtis ir jausmus.

lessons.title: Naujienos ir reakcijos
lessons.titleEn: Catching up – giving news and reacting
lessons.focus: How have you been? What have you been up to? Guess what! Reacting: Really? That's great! Congratulations! Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Lucky you!; showing interest with follow-up questions.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasidalinti naujienomis su draugu ir tinkamai reaguoti į jo naujienas.

lessons.title: Silpnosios formos: have / has
lessons.titleEn: Weak forms and contractions of have/has
lessons.focus: I've, she's (= has), haven't, weak /həv/ in questions (Have you ever /həvjuː/…?), linking; hearing 's = is vs has.
lessons.canDo: Galiu natūraliai ištarti Present Perfect sakinius.

lessons.title: „Ką būtina patirti“ sąrašas
lessons.focus: Graded text about people's bucket lists; comprehension; speaking: your own top 5 experiences you have had / want to have, with reasons.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie svarbiausias savo patirtis ir svajones.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: patirtys
lessons.focus: Present perfect vs past simple, just/already/yet, experience vocabulary, giving news; 'Find someone who has…' conversation.
lessons.canDo: Galiu laisvai kalbėti apie patirtis.

units.title: Namai ir pokyčiai
units.topic: House and home, changes in life, requests

lessons.title: Present Perfect su for / since
lessons.titleEn: Present perfect with for and since; How long…?
lessons.focus: Unfinished states: How long have you lived/worked/known…? for + period, since + point; L1 trap: *I live here for 5 years, *since 5 years.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kiek laiko gyvenu, dirbu ar pažįstu žmogų.

lessons.title: Used to
lessons.titleEn: Used to – past habits and states
lessons.focus: used to/didn't use to/Did you use to…? for past habits and states vs now; talking about how your life/town has changed.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, kaip gyvenau anksčiau ir kas pasikeitė.

lessons.title: Būstas ir buities darbai
lessons.focus: Types of home (detached house, block of flats, studio), renting (rent, landlord, tenant, deposit, bills), make vs do (make the bed, do the washing-up, do the shopping, make dinner).
lessons.canDo: Galiu apibūdinti savo būstą ir buities darbus.

lessons.title: Mandagūs prašymai ir leidimas
lessons.focus: Can/Could you…? Would you mind -ing? Do you mind if I…? Is it OK if I…? Could I possibly…?; replying: Sure, go ahead / I'm afraid not; register: polite vs direct (Lithuanian directness).
lessons.canDo: Galiu mandagiai paprašyti paslaugos ar leidimo ir į tai atsakyti.

lessons.title: Apibrėžiamieji šalutiniai sakiniai
lessons.focus: who/which/that/where for people, things, places (a person who…, a place where…); defining words and paraphrasing when you don't know a word (It's a thing which you use to…).
lessons.canDo: Galiu paaiškinti žodį, kurio nežinau, apibūdindama jį kitais žodžiais.

lessons.title: Balsiai /ʌ/, /æ/, /ɑː/
lessons.focus: cup/cap/carp, much/match, hut/hat/heart, come/calm; avoiding Lithuanian 'a' for all three.
lessons.canDo: Galiu atskirti panašius anglų kalbos balsius.

lessons.title: Būsto apibūdinimas (B1 2 dalis įžanga)
lessons.titleEn: Describing a picture of a home
lessons.focus: Introduction to B1 Preliminary Part 2: describing a photo of a room/home for one minute: where, who, what they're doing, what you think (I can see…, In the background…, It looks like…); short text about tiny houses.
lessons.canDo: Galiu apie minutę apibūdinti nuotrauką su namų scena.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: namai ir pokyčiai
lessons.focus: for/since, used to, relative clauses, housing vocabulary, polite requests; role-play: talking to a landlord.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie būstą ir mandagiai išspręsti buitinius klausimus.

lessons.title: Pinigai ir parduotuvės
lessons.focus: Money verbs: spend, save, waste, lend, borrow, owe, earn, afford, pay by card/in cash, refund, receipt, discount, sale; types of shops and online shopping.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie pinigus, išlaidas ir apsipirkimą.

lessons.title: Too / enough
lessons.focus: too + adjective, (not) + adjective + enough, enough + noun, too much/too many; It's too expensive for me / not big enough.
lessons.canDo: Galiu paaiškinti, kodėl daiktas netinka.

lessons.title: Nežymimieji įvardžiai
lessons.focus: something/anything/nothing, somebody/anyone/nobody, somewhere/everywhere/nowhere; single negation in English (I didn't buy anything – not *I didn't buy nothing; Lithuanian double negation).
lessons.canDo: Galiu vartoti „kažkas“, „niekas“, „visur“ be dvigubo neigimo.

lessons.title: Grąžinimas ir skundas parduotuvėje
lessons.focus: I'd like to return this. It doesn't work / It's damaged / It's the wrong size. Can I have a refund / exchange it? Have you got the receipt? Polite but firm complaints: I'm afraid there's a problem with…
lessons.canDo: Galiu grąžinti prekę ir mandagiai pasiskųsti.

lessons.title: Pirmoji sąlyga
lessons.focus: if + present simple, will/won't/might; when/as soon as/unless; L1 trap: *If it will rain…
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie realias galimybes ir jų pasekmes.

lessons.title: Klausimų intonacija
lessons.focus: Rising intonation in yes/no questions, falling in wh-questions, polite rise in requests; flat Lithuanian-style intonation can sound rude or bored.
lessons.canDo: Galiu klausti su natūralia ir mandagia intonacija.

lessons.title: Apsipirkimas internetu
lessons.focus: Graded article on online vs high-street shopping; pros and cons; expressing preferences (I prefer… because…, I'd rather…); A2 Key Part 2 style comparison of shopping options.
lessons.canDo: Galiu palyginti apsipirkimo būdus ir pasakyti savo nuomonę.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: pirkiniai ir pinigai
lessons.focus: too/enough, indefinite pronouns, first conditional, money vocabulary, complaints; role-play: returning a faulty phone.
lessons.canDo: Galiu susitvarkyti su pirkiniais ir pinigais susijusiose situacijose.

lessons.title: Technologijos ir frazeologiniai veiksmažodžiai
lessons.focus: Devices and actions: charge, download, install, log in/out, turn on/off, plug in, set up, back up, delete, post, share, search; phrasal verbs with objects (turn it off).
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, kaip naudojuosi technologijomis.

lessons.title: Nulinė sąlyga
lessons.focus: if/when + present simple, present simple for general truths and instructions (If you press this button, it turns off); contrast with first conditional.
lessons.canDo: Galiu paaiškinti, kaip kas veikia.

lessons.title: Spėjimai: will, might, may
lessons.focus: will/won't for predictions, might/may for possibility, probably/definitely/certainly position (will probably / probably won't); I think…/I don't think… will.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, kas, mano manymu, įvyks ateityje, ir kiek tuo esu tikra.

lessons.title: Could, be able to: gebėjimas praeityje
lessons.focus: could/couldn't for past ability, was able to for single achievements, will be able to, have been able to; managed to.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ką galėjau ar sugebėjau padaryti praeityje ir ateityje.

lessons.title: Telefonu ir internetu: supratimo tikrinimas
lessons.focus: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you speak more slowly? Do you mean…? What does … mean? Let me check: …; spelling emails and URLs; dealing with tech support.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasitikslinti, ar teisingai supratau, ir paprašyti paaiškinti.

lessons.title: Žodžių sujungimas
lessons.focus: Consonant–vowel linking (turn_it_off, log_in), linking r, avoiding glottal stops between words; reducing choppy syllable-by-syllable speech.
lessons.canDo: Galiu sklandžiau sujungti žodžius kalboje.

lessons.title: Ekrano laikas: nuomonė
lessons.focus: Graded article on screen time and social media; comprehension; giving opinion with reasons: I think…, In my opinion…, because…, for example…
lessons.canDo: Galiu suprasti straipsnį apie technologijas ir išreikšti nuomonę su argumentais.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: technologijos
lessons.focus: Zero/first conditional, predictions, ability, tech vocabulary, clarifying; role-play: calling tech support.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie technologijas ir išspręsti nesusipratimus.

lessons.title: Klausimai: veiksnio klausimai ir prielinksniai gale
lessons.focus: Review of question word order with auxiliaries; subject vs object questions (Who called you? vs Who did you call?); questions ending with prepositions (Who are you talking to? What is it about?).
lessons.canDo: Galiu sklandžiai klausinėti įvairiais klausimų tipais.

lessons.title: Charakteris ir jausmai
lessons.focus: Personality adjectives (friendly, generous, shy, honest, lazy, reliable, selfish, easy-going) and opposites with un-/dis-; -ed/-ing adjectives (bored/boring, interested/interesting).
lessons.canDo: Galiu apibūdinti žmonių charakterį ir savo jausmus.

lessons.title: Veiksmažodžių modeliai
lessons.focus: verb + to (decide, promise, refuse, forget, try), verb + -ing (enjoy, avoid, keep, finish, can't stand), verb + object + to (ask/tell/want someone to); make/let + object + base form.
lessons.canDo: Galiu teisingai jungti veiksmažodžius pasakodama apie žmones.

lessons.title: Nuomonė, sutikimas ir nesutikimas
lessons.focus: I think / I don't think…, In my opinion…, I agree / I'm not sure about that, I see what you mean, but…, Me too / Me neither, So do I / Neither do I; polite softeners.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti nuomonę ir mandagiai sutikti ar nesutikti.

lessons.title: Savybiniai ir sangrąžiniai įvardžiai
lessons.focus: mine/yours/his/hers/ours/theirs, a friend of mine; myself/yourself… (enjoy yourself, by myself) vs each other; L1 trap: Lithuanian 'savo' (*I met with my friend his wife).
lessons.canDo: Galiu tiksliai pasakyti, kieno daiktas, ir vartoti „save“ bei „vienas kitą“.

lessons.title: Sakinio kirtis ir ritmas
lessons.focus: Content vs function words, stress-timed rhythm, contrastive stress for emphasis (I said TUESDAY, not Thursday); English sounds less monotone than syllable-by-syllable.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti natūralesniu anglišku ritmu.

lessons.title: Kaip susipažinome: istorija
lessons.focus: Graded story about how two friends met; retelling with past simple/continuous and linkers (when, while, suddenly, in the end); telling your own 'how I met my best friend' story.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti nuoseklią istoriją apie žmones savo gyvenime.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: žmonės ir santykiai
lessons.focus: Question forms, verb patterns, pronouns, personality vocabulary, opinions; discussion: what makes a good friend.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie žmones ir išreikšti nuomonę.

lessons.title: A2+ lygio egzaminas
lessons.focus: Bridge exam: A2 Key Part 1 interview with extended answers + B1 Preliminary Part 2 photo description (1 minute) + Part 3-style collaborative task (make suggestions, agree/disagree, decide) on a familiar topic; checks present perfect, conditionals, comparisons, opinions.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie patirtį, apibūdinti nuotrauką ir kartu su pašnekovu priimti sprendimą.

levels.name: B1
levels.title: Savarankiškas kalbėtojas
levels.description: Išmoksi pasakoti istorijas, kalbėti apie darbą, sveikatą, keliones, žiniasklaidą ir aplinką, perpasakoti, spėlioti ir diskutuoti. Pabaigoje – pilnas B1 Preliminary kalbėjimo egzamino modelis.

lessons.title: Esamieji laikai ir būsenos veiksmažodžiai
lessons.titleEn: Present simple vs continuous; state verbs
lessons.focus: Revision of present simple vs continuous (habits vs temporary/now); state verbs (know, want, believe, own, seem) not used in continuous; think/have/see with two meanings; L1 trap: *I am knowing.
lessons.canDo: Galiu tiksliai atskirti nuolatinius ir laikinus dalykus kalbėdama apie save.

lessons.title: Būtasis atliktinis laikas (Past Perfect)
lessons.focus: had + past participle for an earlier past event (When I arrived, the train had left); by the time, already, before; contrast with past simple.
lessons.canDo: Galiu aiškiai parodyti, kuris praeities įvykis įvyko anksčiau.

lessons.title: Pasakojimo laikai kartu
lessons.focus: Past simple + past continuous + past perfect in one story; time linkers as soon as, while, after, then, eventually; setting the scene vs main events.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti istoriją vartodama visus tris pasakojimo laikus.

lessons.title: Jausmai ir prieveiksmiai pasakojimui
lessons.focus: Strong adjectives (furious, exhausted, delighted, terrified, astonished), absolutely/really vs very; narrative adverbs: suddenly, luckily, unfortunately, fortunately, immediately, eventually.
lessons.canDo: Galiu gyvai apibūdinti jausmus ir įvykius.

lessons.title: Anekdoto pasakojimas ir susidomėjimo rodymas
lessons.titleEn: Telling an anecdote and showing interest
lessons.focus: Openers (Did I ever tell you about…? You'll never guess what happened), keeping the story going (Anyway, So, Then), ending (In the end…); listener responses: No way! What happened next? You're joking!
lessons.canDo: Galiu įtraukiančiai papasakoti istoriją ir aktyviai klausytis kito pasakojimo.

lessons.title: Had / 'd ir pasakojimo intonacija
lessons.focus: Contracted 'd (I'd = I had / I would), weak /həd/; intonation to build suspense and show emotion; pausing in chunks.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakoti išraiškinga intonacija.

lessons.title: Nuotraukos apibūdinimas (B1 2 dalis)
lessons.titleEn: Describing a photo – B1 Preliminary Part 2
lessons.focus: Strategies for the 1-minute photo description: overview, people, actions, place, guessing (It looks like, He might be, I think it's…, maybe), paraphrasing unknown words (a kind of…, something you use for…); practice with everyday-life photos.
lessons.canDo: Galiu vieną minutę sklandžiai apibūdinti nuotrauką, net jei nežinau kai kurių žodžių.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: istorijos
lessons.focus: Present and narrative tenses, feelings vocabulary, anecdote language; task: tell a story about an unforgettable day.
lessons.canDo: Galiu laisvai papasakoti asmeninę istoriją.

units.title: Darbas ir karjera
units.topic: Work, careers, job interviews, formal language

lessons.title: Darbo sąlygos ir karjera
lessons.focus: apply for a job, CV, interview, salary, contract, permanent/temporary, promotion, get promoted, be made redundant, resign, retire, skills, experience, qualifications, work-life balance.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie darbo sąlygas ir savo karjerą.

lessons.title: Present Perfect Continuous
lessons.focus: have/has been + -ing for ongoing activities (I've been working here since…), recent activity with visible results; contrast with present perfect simple (how long vs how many); state verbs exception.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti, kiek laiko ką nors darau ir ką per tą laiką nuveikiau.

lessons.title: Gerundijus ir prielinksniai
lessons.focus: -ing as subject (Working from home is…), after prepositions (good at, interested in, responsible for, look forward to -ing), adjective/verb + preposition collocations (depend on, apply for, worried about); L1 traps with prepositions.
lessons.canDo: Galiu teisingai vartoti prielinksnius ir -ing formas apibūdindama savo įgūdžius.

lessons.title: Darbo pokalbis
lessons.focus: Tell me about yourself; strengths and weaknesses; I have experience in…; I'm good at…; I've been working as…; asking questions at the end (What would a typical day look like?); answering with examples.
lessons.canDo: Galiu dalyvauti paprastame darbo pokalbyje anglų kalba.

lessons.title: Formali kalba: el. laiškai ir susirinkimai
lessons.titleEn: Formal requests in emails and meetings
lessons.focus: Would it be possible to…? I was wondering if… Could you let me know…? I'd appreciate it if…; opening/closing an email; formal vs informal register; making a suggestion in a meeting.
lessons.canDo: Galiu mandagiai ir formaliai paprašyti ko nors darbe.

lessons.title: Žodžių šeimų kirtis ir /ɜː/–/ɔː/
lessons.focus: Stress shift in word families (eMPLOY, employEE, eMPLOYment; PHOtograph, phoTOgrapher); suffixes -tion/-ity; /ɜː/ vs /ɔː/ (work/walk, firm/form, shirt/short).
lessons.canDo: Galiu teisingai kirčiuoti žodžių šeimas ir ištarti „work“, „world“, „first“.

lessons.title: Nuotolinis darbas: straipsnis ir diskusija
lessons.focus: Graded article on remote work; comprehension and word formation (employ → employer, employment, unemployed; prefixes un-, dis-, im-; suffixes -ful, -less, -ment); balanced opinion with however, although, on the other hand.
lessons.canDo: Galiu suprasti straipsnį apie darbą ir pateikti argumentus už ir prieš.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: darbas ir karjera
lessons.focus: Present perfect continuous, gerunds and prepositions, work vocabulary, interview and formal language; mock interview.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie savo profesinę patirtį.

lessons.title: Ligos, traumos ir gydymas
lessons.focus: flu, infection, allergy, sprain your ankle, cut, bruise, swollen, prescription, operation, painkillers, recover, get over; describing symptoms precisely.
lessons.canDo: Galiu tiksliai apibūdinti ligą ar traumą.

lessons.title: Spėjimo modaliniai veiksmažodžiai
lessons.focus: must/might/may/could/can't + infinitive for deduction (She must be tired. It can't be serious.); contrast with must for obligation; using them to speculate about photos.
lessons.canDo: Galiu spėlioti apie situaciją ir išreikšti, kiek esu tikra.

lessons.title: Antroji sąlyga
lessons.focus: if + past simple, would/could/might for unreal present/future; If I were you…; contrast with first conditional (real vs imaginary); L1 trap: *If I would have…
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie įsivaizduojamas situacijas ir patarti „jei būčiau tavimi“.

lessons.title: Pas gydytoją: išsamiai
lessons.focus: Describing symptoms and their duration (I've had a pain here for…), answering the doctor's questions, asking about treatment and side effects; giving advice: You'd better…, If I were you…, Have you tried…?
lessons.canDo: Galiu išsamiai pasikalbėti su gydytoju ir patarti draugui.

lessons.title: So / such ir stiprinamieji žodžiai
lessons.focus: so + adjective, such (a) + adjective + noun, so… that; intensifiers really/quite/extremely/fairly/a bit; too/enough review with infinitive (too tired to…).
lessons.canDo: Galiu sustiprinti ar sušvelninti savo teiginius.

lessons.title: Bendra užduotis: sveikatos diena (B1 3 dalis)
lessons.focus: Part 3: discussing options for a healthy-lifestyle event with a partner; making and responding to suggestions (What about…? That's a good idea, but…), comparing options and reaching a decision (So, shall we choose…?); sport/fitness vocabulary.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kartu su pašnekovu aptarti galimybes ir susitarti dėl geriausios.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: sveikata
lessons.focus: Modals of deduction, second conditional, so/such, health vocabulary, doctor role-play and advice.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie sveikatą ir patarti.

units.title: Kelionės ir kultūra
units.topic: Travel problems, tourism, customs and festivals

lessons.title: Neveikiamoji rūšis: esamasis ir būtasis
lessons.focus: is/are + past participle, was/were + past participle; by + agent; when to use passive (process, facts, unknown agent): The castle was built in…, English is spoken…
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti apie vietas ir faktus neveikiamąja rūšimi.

lessons.title: Kelionių problemos
lessons.focus: delay, cancel, miss a connection, lost luggage, overbooked, get lost, break down, be stuck in traffic, pickpocket, compensation; collocations with get (get lost, get stuck, get on/off).
lessons.canDo: Galiu apibūdinti nesklandumus kelionėje.

lessons.title: Problemų sprendimas ir skundai kelionėje
lessons.titleEn: Dealing with travel problems and complaints
lessons.focus: Polite complaints at a hotel/airport: I'm afraid there's a problem with… I'd like to speak to the manager. Could you sort it out? What are you going to do about it? Responding to apologies; staying calm and firm.
lessons.canDo: Galiu mandagiai, bet tvirtai pasiskųsti ir išspręsti problemą kelionėje.

lessons.title: Netiesioginiai klausimai
lessons.focus: Could you tell me where the station is? Do you know what time it opens? I wonder if…; word order change (no inversion); L1 trap: *Can you tell me where is the station?
lessons.canDo: Galiu mandagiai klausti informacijos netiesioginiais klausimais.

lessons.title: Neapibrėžiamieji šalutiniai sakiniai
lessons.focus: Non-defining clauses with commas (Vilnius, which is the capital, …), who/which/whose/where/when; no 'that' in non-defining; adding extra information about places and people.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papildyti sakinius papildoma informacija apie vietas ir žmones.

lessons.title: Šventės ir papročiai
lessons.focus: Graded text about festivals in different countries (Joninės, Thanksgiving…); comprehension; vocabulary of customs (celebrate, tradition, take place, decorate); presenting a Lithuanian tradition using the passive and relative clauses.
lessons.canDo: Galiu papasakoti užsieniečiui apie lietuvišką tradiciją.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: kelionės ir kultūra
lessons.focus: Passive, indirect questions, relative clauses, travel problems vocabulary; role-play: lost luggage at the airport.
lessons.canDo: Galiu susitvarkyti kelionių nesklandumus ir kalbėti apie kultūrą.

lessons.title: Naujienos ir žiniasklaida
lessons.focus: headline, article, journalist, reporter, broadcast, channel, the press, social media, influencer, fake news, advert; crime and events basics (rob, arrest, witness, accident, injure).
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie naujienas ir žiniasklaidą.

lessons.title: Netiesioginė kalba: teiginiai
lessons.focus: say vs tell (said that / told me that), tense backshift (is → was, will → would, has done → had done), pronoun and time changes (tomorrow → the next day).
lessons.canDo: Galiu perpasakoti, ką kas nors pasakė.

lessons.title: Netiesioginė kalba: klausimai ir prašymai
lessons.focus: asked if/whether…, asked where I lived (statement word order), told/asked me to…, told me not to…; reporting verbs: explain, promise, suggest (receptive).
lessons.canDo: Galiu perpasakoti klausimus, prašymus ir nurodymus.

lessons.title: Neveikiamoji rūšis: kiti laikai
lessons.focus: Present perfect passive (has been arrested), future passive (will be opened), modal passive (can be done, must be paid), passive in news headlines and reports.
lessons.canDo: Galiu suprasti ir perteikti žinias neveikiamąja rūšimi.

lessons.title: Naujienų perdavimas ir reakcija
lessons.focus: Have you heard about…? Apparently…, According to…, I read that…; reacting with surprise/doubt: Seriously? I don't believe it! That can't be true; showing sympathy.
lessons.canDo: Galiu perduoti naujieną ir išreikšti nuostabą ar abejonę.

lessons.title: Naujienos perpasakojimas
lessons.focus: Graded news article; identifying who/what/where/when/why; summarising the story in your own words with reported speech and passive; discussing how you get news; saying numbers, dates and percentages clearly with contrastive stress (It was in MAY, not March).
lessons.canDo: Galiu savais žodžiais perpasakoti naujienų straipsnį.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: naujienos
lessons.focus: Reported speech, passive tenses, media vocabulary; task: report a conversation and a news story.
lessons.canDo: Galiu perpasakoti pokalbius ir naujienas.

units.title: Aplinka ir ateitis
units.topic: Environment, the natural world, society, the future

lessons.title: Aplinka ir gamta
lessons.focus: pollution, climate change, recycle, waste, rubbish, plastic, energy, renewable, protect, endangered species, global warming, save water; natural world vocabulary (forest, coast, wildlife).
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie aplinkosaugos problemas.

lessons.title: Ateities formos ir Future Continuous
lessons.titleEn: Future forms review and future continuous
lessons.focus: will/going to for predictions (evidence vs opinion), be likely to, future continuous (This time next year I'll be living…), future time clauses (when/before/after + present).
lessons.canDo: Galiu tiksliai kalbėti apie ateities planus ir prognozes.

lessons.title: Trečioji sąlyga
lessons.focus: if + past perfect, would have + past participle for unreal past; contrast with second conditional; weak form /wʊdəv/.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie tai, kas būtų buvę, jei praeityje būtų nutikę kitaip.

lessons.title: Should have / might have: apgailestavimas
lessons.titleEn: Past modals – should have, could have, might have
lessons.focus: should(n't) have, could have, might have + past participle for regret, criticism and past possibility; must have / can't have for past deduction.
lessons.canDo: Galiu išreikšti apgailestavimą ir spėlioti apie praeitį.

lessons.title: Jungtukai: priežastis, priešprieša, tikslas
lessons.focus: because/because of, so, as; although, even though, however, despite (+ -ing/noun), whereas; so that, in order to; On the one hand… on the other hand; organising a spoken argument (Firstly, Another point is, In conclusion).
lessons.canDo: Galiu logiškai susieti argumentus kalbėdama.

lessons.title: Diskusija: argumentavimas
lessons.focus: Expressing strong and tentative opinions, agreeing/disagreeing partly (I agree up to a point), interrupting politely (Sorry to interrupt, but…), asking others' views (What do you think?), turn-taking.
lessons.canDo: Galiu dalyvauti diskusijoje: išsakyti nuomonę, ją pagrįsti ir įtraukti kitus.

lessons.title: Diskusija apie aplinką (B1 4 dalis)
lessons.titleEn: Discussion on the environment – B1 Preliminary Part 4
lessons.focus: Graded text about a zero-waste family; comprehension; B1 Part 4-style discussion: your own habits, experiences and opinions on environmental issues, giving reasons and examples.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kelias minutes diskutuoti apie visuomenės temą, pagrįsdama nuomonę pavyzdžiais.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: aplinka ir ateitis
lessons.focus: Future forms, third conditional, past modals, linking words, environment vocabulary; debate: 'Cars should be banned from city centres'.
lessons.canDo: Galiu argumentuotai kalbėti apie ateitį ir aplinką.

lessons.title: Used to, would ir be used to
lessons.titleEn: Past habits – used to and would
lessons.focus: used to vs would for repeated past actions (would not for states), childhood memories; be/get used to + -ing (receptive contrast).
lessons.canDo: Galiu gyvai papasakoti savo vaikystės prisiminimus.

lessons.title: Pritariamieji klausimai (question tags)
lessons.focus: Tags with be, do, have, modals and different tenses (It's cold, isn't it? You didn't call, did you?); using tags to check and to make conversation.
lessons.canDo: Galiu vartoti „ar ne?“ tipo klausimus, kad pasitikslinčiau ar palaikyčiau pokalbį.

lessons.title: I wish ir if only
lessons.focus: I wish / If only + past simple for present wishes (I wish I had more time; I wish I could…); contrast with hope; link to second conditional.
lessons.canDo: Galiu pasakyti, ko norėčiau, kad būtų kitaip dabartyje.

lessons.title: Santykiai: frazeologiniai veiksmažodžiai
lessons.focus: get on (well) with, fall out with, make up, go out with, break up, look after, bring up, grow up, get together, keep in touch, rely on; both/either/neither, so/neither do I.
lessons.canDo: Galiu kalbėti apie santykius natūraliais frazeologiniais veiksmažodžiais.

lessons.title: Pasiūlymai ir susitarimas
lessons.focus: Making and responding to suggestions (Why don't we…? I'd rather… What if we…?), negotiating (That's true, but…, How about a compromise?), reaching a decision (OK, let's go with…); small talk openers and keeping conversation going.
lessons.canDo: Galiu derėtis ir susitarti su pašnekovu, palaikyti nerišlų pokalbį.

lessons.title: Pritariamųjų klausimų intonacija
lessons.focus: Falling tag (checking, expecting agreement) vs rising tag (real question); rising/falling patterns in suggestions and responses; linking and weak forms review.
lessons.canDo: Galiu intonacija parodyti, ar klausiu, ar tikiuosi pritarimo.

lessons.title: Kartojimas: santykiai ir prisiminimai
lessons.focus: used to/would, question tags, wishes, relationship phrasal verbs, negotiating; full B1 conversation practice on family and friends.
lessons.canDo: Galiu laisvai kalbėti apie santykius ir prisiminimus.

lessons.title: B1 lygio egzaminas
lessons.focus: Full B1 Preliminary Speaking model: Part 1 interview (personal details, routines, likes, past/future); Part 2 one-minute photo description; Part 3 collaborative task with visual prompts (suggest, discuss alternatives, decide); Part 4 general discussion on the Part 3 theme (opinions, experiences, reasons). Assessed on grammar & vocabulary range, discourse management, pronunciation and interactive communication.
lessons.canDo: Galiu išlaikyti B1 Preliminary kalbėjimo dalies modelį: kalbu sklandžiai, argumentuoju ir bendradarbiauju pokalbyje.
